name: Maitri Prashikshan Karyakram - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board
benefit: - **In Hilly Districts:** ₹100/- per artificial insemination, with a minimum target of 25 to 30 inseminations.- **In Plain Districts:** ₹100/- per artificial insemination, with a minimum target of 50 to 60 inseminations.
_eligibility_text: It is mandatory for registered Artificial Insemination workers to record all AI-related data on the Bharat Pashudhan App. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must possess a minimum educational qualification of High School. 1. The applicant must obtain a recommendation in the prescribed format from both the Local Veterinary Officer and the Chief Veterinary Officer.
